description:
About our brand and products

NAE Vegan Shoes is a Portuguese footwear and accessories brand creating stylish, high-quality products that are 100% vegan and ethically made. We combine timeless design with innovative, sustainable materials such as organic cotton, recycled fabrics, Piñatex®, cork, and recycled microfiber to offer conscious alternatives without compromising on comfort or style.

What makes us different

At NAE, sustainability goes beyond being vegan. We carefully select low-impact materials, work with responsible manufacturing partners in Portugal, and design products that are made to last. Our collections combine minimalist aesthetics, premium craftsmanship, and a genuine commitment to animal welfare and environmental responsibility.

How affiliates can earn

As a NAE affiliate, you'll earn a commission on every qualified sale generated through your unique referral link. You'll also gain access to an easy-to-use affiliate dashboard where you can track clicks, sales, commissions, and performance in real time.

How to promote us

Share your unique affiliate links on your website, blog, social media channels, newsletters, YouTube, or other content platforms. We encourage authentic content such as product reviews, styling ideas, sustainability tips, unboxing videos, and lifestyle inspiration that aligns with our brand values.

Other information

We're looking to build long-term relationships with affiliates who are passionate about ethical fashion, sustainability, vegan living, and conscious consumption. Whether you're a content creator, blogger, publisher, or community leader, we'd love to work with you to inspire more people to choose fashion with a positive impact.

Welcome to NAE Vegan Shoes! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant ("we" or "merchant") and an affiliate ("you" or "affiliate") who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else's referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you're not assigned a branded coupon, then you're not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate's link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There's no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: alex.perez@nae-vegan.com.

8. Brand and Intellectual Property Use

Affiliate is granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use NAE Vegan Shoes' name, logo, product images, and marketing materials solely for the purpose of promoting the merchant's products through the Affiliate Program. Affiliate may not modify, distort, or use these materials in a way that misrepresents the brand, implies an official partnership beyond that of an affiliate, or damages the reputation of NAE Vegan Shoes. Any unauthorized use of the brand's intellectual property will result in immediate termination from the Program.

9. Prohibited Practices

Affiliate agrees not to engage in the following practices: bidding on "NAE," "NAE Vegan Shoes," or any confusingly similar terms as keywords in paid search campaigns (e.g., Google Ads, Bing Ads); using spam, misleading advertising, cookie-stuffing, or any form of automated or fraudulent traffic generation; or engaging in self-referrals or purchases made through one's own affiliate link for the purpose of generating commission. Violation of this clause will result in forfeiture of any related commissions and may lead to immediate termination from the Program.

10. Fraud Prevention and Commission Reversal

We reserve the right to review, withhold, reverse, or deny any commission that we reasonably believe resulted from fraudulent, abusive, or manipulative activity, including but not limited to coupon leakage to deal/coupon sites without authorization, fake orders, or the use of prohibited practices described in Section 9. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate an Affiliate's account, without prior notice, in cases of suspected fraud.

11. Affiliate's Independent Status

Affiliate acknowledges and agrees that they are an independent participant in the Program and not an employee, agent, partner, or legal representative of NAE Vegan Shoes. Affiliate has no authority to make representations, warranties, or commitments on behalf of NAE Vegan Shoes, nor to enter into any contract or obligation binding the merchant.

12. Data Protection

Any personal data shared by the Affiliate (including but not limited to name, email address, and payment details) will be processed by NAE Vegan Shoes in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and used solely for the purposes of administering the Affiliate Program. Affiliate may request access to, correction of, or deletion of their personal data at any time by contacting alex.perez@nae-vegan.com.

13. Confidentiality of Commission Terms

Affiliate agrees to keep their individual commission rate and any specific terms negotiated with NAE Vegan Shoes confidential, and not to disclose such information publicly or to other affiliates or third parties, unless expressly authorized by the merchant.

14. Governing Law and Amendments

These Terms and Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Portugal and the applicable regulations of the European Union. Any dispute arising from participation in the Program shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Portugal. NAE Vegan Shoes reserves the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Changes will take effect upon publication on the Affiliate platform, and continued participation in the Program constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to alex.perez@nae-vegan.com for support.
